annotations.title: A brief for a coding agent

description: One item's brief to hand to the coding agent that builds the screen: the same Markdown the docs page's "Copy for a coding agent" button copies (what the item is, its tier and install command, an example with the import paths an app uses, every prop, the string keys, and the rules to keep).

version.description: A release, e.g. "6.1.0", the version the project has installed. Default: the version the server's URL passes (`?kit=`, which `npx candor-ui mcp` writes from candor-lock.json). Candor UI serves only the current release's docs, so for any other version the answer is the current page with a note saying so.
